entities.name: Cliffs of Kazuul
entities.description: A guarded mountain passage into the continent of Murasa on Zendikar, the only maintained ascent of Murasa's Wall.

entities.name: Kazuul
entities.description: An ogre slave-master and current ruler of the pass who demands tribute.

entities.name: Murasa
entities.description: The continent on Zendikar the cliffs lead into.

entities.name: Tajuru
entities.description: The elves who set up the cliff ascent.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where the cliffs lie.

events.summary: Kazuul, an ogre slave-master, rules the pass and demands tribute from any who seek passage.
events.quote: an ogre slave-master who demands tribute from any who seek passage

relations.note: He is the pass's current ruler.

relations.quote: a guarded mountain passage into the continent of Murasa
